name: Manchester

portalsFound.observation: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons (freehold titles, England and Wales) are distributed as per-local-authority downloads (Manchester would be one of them); the download URL redirected (302) to a Cloudflare challenge for curl, so no file was obtained. Not a queryable API. Licence not read here.
Land Registry INSPIRE OGC endpoint: WFS GetFeature returns an OWS ServiceUnavailable exception; WMS capabilities answer (images only).
Manchester City Council site behind a Cloudflare challenge (403 'Just a moment') for curl; no parcel service seen.
data.gov.uk catalogue (reached after redirect) lists INSPIRE index polygon datasets from HM Land Registry; not tested for a bbox service.
Third-party ArcGIS copies found cover Northumberland/Cumbria, the Thames Valley and Oxfordshire-area extents, none covering Manchester; the earlier London probe recorded similar extents.

requests.assessment: redirected to ckan.publishing.service.gov.uk; catalogue metadata only

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: HM Land Registry INSPIRE index polygons for England and Wales (download only)

remainingUncertainty: No bounded polygon response was obtained. The official INSPIRE download likely covers Manchester but requires a session/account step that curl did not complete; Ordnance Survey products need a key. Licence terms were not read.
nextStep: Complete the HMLR INSPIRE download for Manchester in a real browser session (or use the OS Data Hub with a key) and extract a small bbox sample; look for a Greater Manchester or Trafford/Salford ArcGIS service.
